summary: Smoke-tested Modulate Velma-2 web app. Backend: /api/config, /api/transcribe (audio mp3 + video mp4), /api/history list/item/delete all return 200 with expected payloads. Frontend: UI loads, all 5 parameter switches visible, Transcribe button correctly disabled until file selected and enabled after, History drawer opens and shows 2 real records with TXT/SRT/JSON/delete buttons, theme toggle works. No console errors (only a11y DialogContent description warning).
passed: POST /api/transcribe (mp3 sine tone) => 200, record with id/filename/duration_ms=3000/segment_count=0/result (empty utterances expected for tone)
POST /api/transcribe (mp4 testsrc+sine) => 200, ffmpeg video->audio extraction works, record created
GET /api/history => sorted desc by created_at, lightweight payload
Frontend home page loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL
transcribe-submit-button disabled before file, enabled after set_input_files on file-dropzone-input
history-open-button opens history-drawer with history-item-row entries
notes: Minor non-blocking a11y warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' in history drawer. Not a bug blocker. Modulate API responds in ~10-15s for 3s tone — real transcription latency is acceptable.
